approved.dataset_scope: Understanding synthetic v1 for prompt-only baseline and pilot
approved.prompt_strategy: zero-shot prompt-only with strict structured output

recorded_divergences.resolution: Keep the real CLI blocked until a separate human decision selects a model/base and authorizes its provider.
Run the iterative baseline only on synthetic DEV. Keep synthetic holdout unopened until the pilot configuration is frozen.
Preserve confidence because it belongs to the approved schema, report MAE/exact match, and do not use it as a safety or production gate.
Structural checks permit the pilot, but production approval still requires semantic and industrial review.
Record model invocations in the dedicated append-only agent log. Never create EvidenceRecord entries from Understanding outputs.

requirements_before_unblocking: Select and record one model/base suitable for both prompt-only baseline and a comparable future fine-tuning path.
Approve the provider adapter and credential environment variable without storing secrets in the repository.
Define a maximum token/cost budget and timeout policy.
Define retention and redaction rules for provider requests and responses.
Keep ACTION unavailable and keep the official Golden Set outside runtime and tuning.
